description: Returns a small set of passages from Fiveable study guides that are most relevant to one question. Use this for narrow explanations, research questions, and checking student notes instead of fetching a full guide. One call consumes one full-content preview for a free caller.

guideSlug.description: Optional exact guide reference from get_subject_outline or search_content.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

query.description: The concept or question the student needs help with.

subjectSlug.description: Fiveable subject slug, e.g. "ap-bio". A course name such as "AP Biology" also resolves.

name: get_content_sections

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: Get relevant study guide sections
